purpose: Logical business capability catalog. Physical placement is defined separately by the Infrastructure Definition.

services.description: Checks that the loan application is complete: an application ID, income above zero and a requested amount above zero.
Grades the applicant's credit score: 700 or more is strong, 620 or more needs review, anything lower is weak.
services.returns: Credit check results with credit_status strong, review or weak. Always routes on "loan".

services.description: Flags the application when its fraud risk is high.
services.returns: Fraud check results with fraud_status flagged or clear. No routing value.

services.description: Combines the credit and fraud results into a lending decision.
services.returns: Underwriting results. Routes on "approved" (score 700 or more and low fraud risk), "declined" (high fraud risk or score below 600) or "conditional" (anything else).

services.description: Records the final loan decision, taken from underwriting.
services.returns: Decision results with the final decision and status complete. No routing value.

services.description: Marks the applicant as verified when an application ID is present. Kept for future workflows; not deployed.
Checks that a verified applicant can afford the loan: the loan is at most 35% of income and the credit score is 620 or more. Kept for future workflows; not deployed.
services.returns: Affordability results: affordable, review or identity_review. Always routes on "prescreen_complete".
